newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil weaker with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil weaker with crude.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were notionally weaker as crude oil futures and cracked fuel oil prices fell back, traders said.

An ARA refiner on Wednesday night bought an E-4 cargo out of Klaipeda, containing around 1.5 percent water, at no premium to the m/m/m of published quotes, cif NWE. Cargoes with a low water content, however were assessed at around m/m/m +$4.
In the Med, an Italian refiner was heard to have bought an M-40 cargo, loading in the Black Sea in early to mid February, at around $3 a tonne over the m/m/m of published Med quotes.
